The '''Y41-C2LC Conjo fighter''' was an [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] atmospheric fighter craft.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Characteristics==
Used by local militias in remote colonies, it measured 14 meters long and was equipped with a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launcher and two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
Three [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of these fighters fought in the [[Battle of G'rho]].
